admission.justification: Requiring authored applicability, conditions and exclusions prevents an invariant from being stored without semantic boundaries and later mistaken for a broader guarantee than its author established.

applicability: Creation of invariant revisions from a curator handoff with one or more resolved targets.
conditions: The curator supplies nonblank applicability and explicit lists of conditions and exclusions.
Scope validation runs before invariant identity allocation and writes, including preview.
exclusions: This admission rule does not retroactively rewrite historical stored scope.
A targetless ruling is not an invariant revision.
The retired database-era realization site; the obligation is recorded on converted memory only.
statement: An invariant ingested from a curator hand-off carries curator-authored semantic scope, and an unfilled scope refuses that entry before invariant writes.
